entities.name: Betrayers of Kamigawa
entities.description: The thirty-fourth Magic expansion, second set of the Kamigawa block, released February 2005.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: A ronin now in the employ of Princess Michiko and beholden to the Myojin of Night's Reach.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: A powerful spirit to whom Toshi is beholden.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane threatened by the Kami War and a spirit beast.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war threatening to engulf Kamigawa.

entities.name: The Daimyo
entities.description: A figure at the heart of the battle whose impassive features conceal a sinister crime.

events.summary: Toshi, in Michiko's employ and beholden to the Myojin of Night's Reach, tries to honor his commitments as the Kami War threatens Kamigawa and a spirit beast threatens the world.
events.quote: But as the Kami War threatens to engulf Kamigawa , an unimaginably powerful spirit beast threatens the world.
